| r2f1 | defect | MINOR | NEW. The amended G5 says "current Rust and TypeScript clients require exactly v2". That is true of the CLI (`crates/cli/src/client.rs:524`, `untyped.v != ENVELOPE_VERSION`) and of the extension (`daemon-wire.ts:163`), but NOT of every Rust client: `crates/daemon/src/http/client.rs:252 decode_peer_envelope` — the daemon-to-daemon federation client — calls `wire::decode_envelope`, which refuses only `found &gt; ENVELOPE_VERSION` and therefore ACCEPTS a v1 peer. So one real client floors while two pin, and the sentence written specifically to replace a false promise is itself not quite true about the one property it asserts. This matters beyond pedantry: G5 is now the text a reader consults to decide whether a mixed-version fleet is safe, and it currently implies federation would detect the skew when federation would silently accept it. SMALLEST FIX: name the asymmetry in G5 — "the CLI and the extension pin v2; the federation peer client accepts v ≤ 2" — or make `decode_peer_envelope` pin so the sentence becomes true as written. I do not think this blocks the PR; it is one clause in a goal. | docs/plans/128-seat-session-identity/plan.dd.md#goals | [ ] unchecked | — | — | — | — | crates/core/src/wire.rs:92 `if found &gt; ENVELOPE_VERSION`; crates/daemon/src/http/client.rs:252 `wire::decode_envelope(&body)`; contrasted with client.rs:524 and daemon-wire.ts:163, both exact-equality. |
